content: वप्रः, -प्रम् [उप्यते अत्र वप्-रन् <ls>Uṇ. 2. 27</ls>] .²1 A rampart, earth-work, mud-wall; वेलावप्रवलयाम् (उर्वीम्) <ls>R. 1. 30</ls>; द्वितीयामिव मामत्र वप्रमालम्ब्य तिष्ठत <ls>Śiva B.</ls> .²2 A bank or mound of any kind (against which bulls and elephants butt); शृङ्गाग्रलग्नाम्बुदवप्रपङ्कः <ls>R. 13. 47</ls>; see वप्रक्रीडा below. .²3 The slope or declivity of a hill or rocky place; बृहच्छिलावप्रघनेन वक्षसा <ls>Ki. 14. 40</ls>. .²4 A summit, peak, table-land on a mountain; तीव्रं महाव्रतमिवात्र चरन्ति वप्राः <ls>Śi. 4. 58</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">3. 37</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 36</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">6. 8</ls>. .²5 The bank of a river, side, shore, bank in general; ध्वनयः प्रतेनुरनुवप्रमपाम् <ls>Ki. 6. 4</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">7. 11</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">17. 58</ls>. .²6 The foundation of a building. .²7 The gate of a fortified town. .²8 A ditch. .²9 The circumference of a sphere. .²10 A field in general; विकासि वप्राम्भसि गन्धसूचितम् <ls>Ki. 4. 26</ls>. .²11 The butting of an elephant or bull. .²12 Dust. .²13 A multitude, a heap; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-प्रः@} .²1 A father. .²2 A Prajāpati. .{@-प्रम्@} .²1 Lead. .²2 Gold; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-प्रा@} .²1 A flat bank of earth. .²2 Garden-bed.
